title: cs-daily-scratchpad-2026-03-04
body:
Daily scratchpad - quick hits and reminders
Date: 2026-03-04
Owner: Alex Chen (CS)

TOP PRIORITY ACCOUNTS
- Acme Corp (Enterprise) — QBR prep due 2026-03-10
  * What to include: usage trends (tokens/day), latency/cost summary, top prompts, recommended batching/quantization changes, action items from last QBR
  * Notes: Customer concerned about token spend spike in Feb; engineering asked for sample traces (sent to eng-sre).
  * Next: Draft 1 of deck by 2026-03-06. Samira to review. Request: add cost-optimization bullet (caching suggestion).

- BetaBank (FinReg) — Renewal window 2026-04-15 (60-day prep)
  * Contract: review auto-renew clauses; escalate pricing discrepancy (finance) if usage > committed.
  * Compliance: ensure Private deployment checklist attached (KMS/HSM questions).
  * Action: schedule renewal kickoff with AM + Legal by 2026-03-12.

SUPPORT / FOLLOW-UPS
- TKT-11234 (Acme) — model responses inconsistent on low-entropy prompts
  * Status: engineering triage (assigned to eng-applied-ml). Follow-up expected 2026-03-05.
- TKT-11567 (Canvas Health) — latency spikes in us-west-2 on dedicated pool
  * Status: SRE running perf logs. Ask for remediation ETA.
- JIRA-7890 — rollout rollback issue for canary 2
  * Note: correlate with traffic route policy changes (console).

DAILY TO-DO (today)
- [ ] Draft Acme QBR deck outline (priority)
- [ ] Sync with Samira on BetaBank renewal playbook
- [ ] Ping eng-sre for latency logs TKT-11567
- [ ] Update renewal tracker sheet with new dates (link in linked_artifacts)
- [ ] Quick triage of inbox: flagged renewals >30d

MEETINGS
- 09:30 — Standup (CS) — share QBR timelines (15m)
- 11:00 — BetaBank discovery call (30m) — confirm compliance checklist owner
- 15:00 — Acme prep sync with Samira (45m)

NOTES / OBSERVATIONS
- Several smaller customers are moving to Redwood Dedicated for cost predictability; capture playbook notes for mid-market renewals.
- Consider templating a "cost snapshot" slide with top-3 recommendations (batching, cache, quantization) for faster QBR prep.

OPEN QUESTIONS
- Who owns the private-deploy KMS integration questions for BetaBank? (Need contact from security team)
- Can we get a sample of the low-entropy prompts from Acme to reproduce locally?

END-OF-DAY LOG (quick)
- 2026-03-04 17:30: drafted QBR slide outline (50%); sent to Samira for review.
- 2026-03-04 16:00: escalated BetaBank contract item to Legal (LR ticket created).
- 2026-03-04 14:00: requested perf logs from SRE for Canvas Health (waiting).
action_items: Draft Acme QBR deck outline by 2026-03-06
Get perf logs for TKT-11567 and confirm ETA
quick_notes: Template cost-snapshot slide to speed QBRs
Escalated legal for BetaBank pricing discrepancy
